name: machzero-android
description: Google Play Android wrapper for MachZero™

scripts.android:init: npm run prepare:web && npx cap add android && node scripts/configure-android.mjs && npx cap sync android && node scripts/configure-android.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android && node scripts/configure-android.mjs
scripts.android:aab: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
